ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio estimated at 1:10 (high-intensity white pixels vs. low-intensity dark pigment), with high intensity localized to circular scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark contiguous base pigmentation with high-contrast white circular blobs clustered at distal terminal lobes (far left and far right edges) and sparse, isolated circular rings across the central lobe areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with an approximate 30-degree interior angle and significant depth relative to the inner lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular high-frequency serration featuring jagged peaks and steep valleys (amplitude ~10-15 pixels) across the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a concave upward sweep leading to tapered, sharp terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular white pixel clusters at both the far left and far right tips of the fluke; scattered smaller, high-contrast rings (barnacle scars) across the medial surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, parallel diagonal linear disruptions (scratches) visible on the medial portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy concentration of rosette scarring and barnacle colonization remnants at distal fluke tips; multiple circular impact/parasitic scars across surface area.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely jagged and deeply serrated trailing edge profile relative to typical species topography.
